description: The Record Book for one promotion in one call: the top rows of every leaderboard, grouped by category — the all-time and single-night records an agent quotes. Narrow by division, country, active fighters or one scope.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 nationality, e.g. "BR" — fighters from that country. Not with population=active.

org.description: Promotion slug (required — the Record Book is per promotion).

population.description: all (default) = everyone who fought in the promotion; active = a bout in the last ~18 months.

scope.description: One kind of board: career, single_fight, round, division or event. Omit for all.

top.description: Rows per board. Default 3 here (the whole book at 10 rows is ~140 KB); up to 25.

name: get_record_book
title: Get the record book
